tools.name: search_gtm_tools
tools.description: Find candidate GTM tools by name or task. Returns catalog IDs, dates, source links and recorded MCP status; does not verify suitability.

tools.name: get_company_guide
tools.description: Retrieve the sourced guide for a company slug or catalog ID. Only selected companies have detailed research. Suite IDs return choose_product with separate guide IDs. Unknown IDs return not_researched.

tools.name: research_gtm_question
tools.description: Retrieve evidence for a plain-English tool question. Returns citations, scope labels and company-level limitations with source links. Limitations may not apply to every answer. Restrict company_id when asking about one vendor. Use evidence_type=vendor_documentation for documented capabilities or edi

tools.name: compare_gtm_tools
tools.description: Compare two to five exact catalog IDs from search_gtm_tools, preserving unknown detailed coverage and individual sources.

tools.name: get_gtm_updates
tools.description: Read reviewed updates, optionally for a company slug. Research additions are distinct from vendor announcements; monitoring coverage is explicit.

tools.name: plan_gtm_workflow
tools.description: Build a design only for intent expansion-account-review from a complete structured request. Returns the artifact, plan, source provenance, missing questions, and a non-sending message preview. Unsupported intents/adapters return supported scope and missing capabilities. The request follows the bundl

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: plan_gtm_workflow · Private data: plan_gtm_workflow · Public sink: plan_gtm_workflow · Destructive: plan_gtm_workflow.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: plan_gtm_workflow · Private data: plan_gtm_workflow · Public sink: plan_gtm_workflow · Destructive: plan_gtm_workflow

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
